invariant: The public function signature cannot change.
No third-party dependencies may be added.
Existing files must never be overwritten and must raise FileExistsError.
Service errors must continue to propagate to the caller.
Unknown configuration keys must remain errors.
Sensitive values must never appear in logs.
The existing serialized JSON schema cannot change.
The component must not perform network requests.
Existing CLI flags and their behavior must remain supported.
Processing the same event twice must not duplicate its effect.
Authorization must succeed before any state mutation occurs.
